snippet.title: Serious Sam Alpha (Remake v1.5) | Green Planet | Playthrough
snippet.description:
Serious Sam Alpha Remake is a mod created by Zdzichu for Serious Sam The First Encounter. The current version I am playing on is Version 1.5.

Level: Green Planet
Campaign: Green Planet
Mod: Serious Sam Alpha (Remake)
Performance: Laggy, you need to turn off lens flares to fix it.
